Name: Shabby Chic Bathroom for Cozier Default Farmhouse
Author: adafsdghfjgm
Description:
[b][size=3]
﻿Installation:[/size]
[/b]
[list=1]
[*][size=2]Make sure you’ve installed [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7289]Cozier Default Farmhouses Mod[/url]﻿.[/size]
[*][size=2]Download my file provided and overwrite the z_bathroom_tiles.png in the farmhouses mod assets with mine. [/size]
[*][size=2]You should be finished now :) Basic rule of this "mod" is to rewrite the existing files and replace with the one i provided.[/size]
[/list][size=3]
[b]Compatibility[/b]:

[/size][list]
[*][size=2]Before installing CDF, please make sure to remove ALL of the furniture you've placed in the upstairs area or else it'll look weird and have tiles standing out.[/size]
[/list][size=2]
[/size][list]
[*][size=2]You can use farmhouse retextures for the lower half of the house but none upstairs if you wish to use this mod, it won't let you use wallpaper or flooring on most of the misplaced tiles so that's why it's preferred to just use farmhouse mods for the downstairs area i.e kitchen or living room/spouse region. [/size]
[/list][size=2]
[/size][list]
[*][size=2]There is more information regarding compatibility on the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7289?tab=posts]original mods' page [/url]﻿and my file is simply just a retexture to rewrite over it. [/size]
[/list]

[b]FYI: I am using the All Upgrades option on the original page, You can use the bathroom tiles and edit it towards which assignment of the farm you like from DMO's page too. This is NOT my work and I only reassigned the tilesheets to fit my liking. [/b]
